text:
maya: Quick preflight — planning cutover tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runtime v2.3.0, API v5.1, Router shim 1.8. Need compatibility ack, pinning, and rollback criteria. Deploy bot will start canary at 02:10. @eng-runtime @eng-api @eng-router

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime:v2.3.0 -> 2% traffic at 02:10 UTC, escalate to 25% at 02:30 if green. Command: `/deploy start --service runtime --version v2.3.0 --canary 2%`

leo: runtime: LGTM on perf tests. KV eviction pattern changed — watch memory during warmup. I'll add a metric alert: `runtime.proc_p99_mem > 78% for 5m` -> rollback.

sandeep: API team: v5.1 adds stricter schema for tool-calls. Console depends on older optional fields. Console must be pinned to API v5.1-compatible branch. We'll cut a console build now — tag `console:release-api5.1`.

anna: Router: shim 1.8 has extended header mux. Minor risk for grpc fallback. Router team will pin until 03:00 then observe. Rollback plan: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 10m or latency p95 up 40% -> rollback router.

maya: OK, can we list exact rollback triggers for each service? I'll assemble in release notes snippet.

leo: runtime rollback triggers:
- token latency p95 > baseline * 1.5 for 10m
- error-rate > 0.3% for 5m
- mem pressure alert (as above)
I'll set those in monitor.

sandeep: API rollback triggers:
- schema-validation errors > 100/hr
- 5xx > 0.2% for 5m
- failing canary tests: `/e2e/canary-api` -> non-zero

anna: Router rollback triggers:
- 5xx at edge > 0.5% (10m)
- grpc fallback rate increase > 3x baseline
- route mismatch > 0.1%

maya: Release notes snippet (drop-in):
```
runtime v2.3.0: KV eviction improvements, faster kv-prefetch, requires router shim >=1.8
api v5.1: stricter tool-call schema, backward-compatible with console:release-api5.1
router shim v1.8: header muxing, GRPC fallback fix
Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary start 02:10.
Rollback criteria per-monitoring above. Owners: @leo (runtime), @sandeep (api), @anna (router), @maya (release)
```

deploy-bot: Canary started for runtime:v2.3.0 at 02:10 UTC on alpha group. Logs -> https://deploy/log/3067891234/runtime-canary

ops-runner-bot: Noted windows. Automatic pin applied: console pinned to `console:release-api5.1` for the window.

leo: Seeing slight mem bump on canary pods, ~5% above baseline. Not yet at threshold. Will watch.

sandeep: API canary e2e passed. Schema errors 0.

anna: Router canary traffic small, grpc fallback unchanged.

maya: Good. We'll hold at small canary until 02:30 then move to 25% if green. If any trigger fires, we rollback to previous versions (runtime v2.2.7, api v5.0.9, router 1.7.4). Who will initiate rollback?

leo: Runtime rollback I'll trigger, as owner.

sandeep: API rollback I'll coordinate with leo if cross-service required.

anna: Router rollback I'll run but will coordinate with infra for route reinstatement.

maya: I'll publish release note and notify SRE and support. tagging: @sre @support.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 25% at 02:31 UTC (auto-step). Change traffic table: alpha->25%.

ops-runner-bot: Reminder — after 03:30 UTC we'll start gradual full rollout if no alerts for 30m.

leo: No alerts after 15m. mem trending down. Approving promotion.

sandeep: Safe to proceed to full rollout at 03:50 if no new signals.

anna: Router metrics stable.

maya: Advise: hold final roll to 04:00 to avoid crossing maintenance window. Proceed at 03:50 with final checks. I'll update thread if anything.
